control.description-key: Shows the representative what the customer already told the Copilot Studio agent, warns when they ask for it again, and scores the handoff.

property.name: boundField
property.description-key: Any text column on the conversation form. Used as the brief only if it contains brief JSON.

property.name: briefVariableName
property.description-key: Context variable that carries the brief JSON from Copilot Studio.

property.name: liveReaskCheck
property.description-key: Watch the live transcript and warn when the representative asks for something the customer already gave.

property.name: saveScores
property.description-key: Write a Handoff Quality row per conversation (needs the zrh_handoffquality table).

property.name: pollSeconds
property.description-key: How often to check the live transcript.

property.name: demoMode
property.description-key: Show sample data and replay a representative re-asking, for demos and testing.

property.name: conversationIdOverride
property.description-key: For testing: read a specific conversation instead of the form record.
